ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The left side of the figure is labeled Port 1, and the right side is labeled Port 2; inside the dashed box in the middle is an ideal transformer, with the turns ratio labeled n:1; the right-side Port 2 is terminated with an inductive element, labeled L. Reasoning: The inductive load impedance on Port 2 is Z_L = sL. For an ideal transformer, if the turns ratio from Port 1 to Port 2 is n:1, then when the secondary-side impedance is reflected to the primary side, it is multiplied by n^2, therefore Z_in = n^2 Z_L = n^2 sL. Comparing it with the equivalent inductance impedance form Z_in = sL_eq gives L_eq = n^2L.

raw_record.question_text: If an ideal transformer has an inductive load element at port 2 as shown in the image, the equivalent inductance at port 1 is ______.

method.method_draft: Identify from the image that the inductor L is connected at port 2, the secondary side of an ideal transformer whose ratio is n:1 from port 1 to port 2. Treat the inductor as an impedance Z_L = sL. Reflect this impedance through the ideal transformer to port 1 using Z_in = n^2 Z_L. Then compare Z_in = n^2 sL with the form sL_eq to obtain L_eq = n^2L.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中左侧标为 Port 1，右侧标为 Port 2；中间虚线框内是理想变压器，匝比标注为 n:1；右侧 Port 2 端接有一个电感元件，标为 L。推理：Port 2 上的电感负载阻抗为 Z_L = sL。对理想变压器，若从 Port 1 到 Port 2 的匝比为 n:1，则二次侧阻抗反射到一次侧时乘以 n^2，因此 Z_in = n^2 Z_L = n^2 sL。将其与等效电感阻抗形式 Z_in = sL_eq 比较，得到 L_eq = n^2L。

method.method_draft: From the diagram, assign the left winding as port 1 and the right winding with the inductor L as port 2, with turns ratio n:1. Apply the ideal transformer relation v1 = n v2. The load inductor satisfies v2 = L di2/dt. Relate the currents through the transformer using i2 = n i1 in magnitude for the chosen port reference directions. Then v1 = nL d(n i1)/dt = n^2L di1/dt. Comparing with v1 = L_eq di1/dt gives L_eq = n^2L.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中虚线框内是一个理想变压器，左侧绕组标为 Port 1，右侧绕组标为 Port 2；变压器上方标注匝数比为 n:1。右侧端口外接了一个电感元件，标注为 L。推理：按图中将左绕组作为端口1、右绕组及其电感负载作为端口2。理想变压器电压关系为 v1 = n v2。端口2的电感满足 v2 = L·di2/dt。按所给端口参考方向取电流幅值关系 i2 = n i1。因此 v1 = n·L·d(n i1)/dt = n²L·di1/dt。与端口1看到的等效电感关系 v1 = Leq·di1/dt 比较，得到 Leq = n²L。
